storyQuote: What began as tinkering with a 3D printer turned into a shop full of things I actually wanted to make — practical pieces, fun gifts, and the occasional just-because-it-looked-cool design. Every item is printed, checked, and packed by hand, one layer at a time.

policies.title: Shipping
policies.body: See each item's listing for estimated arrival times.

policies.title: Payment options
policies.body: Secure checkout through Etsy. Accepts Etsy Gift Cards and Etsy Credits. Etsy shops never receive your credit card information.

policies.title: Returns & exchanges
policies.body: See each item's listing for return and exchange eligibility.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.body: Cancellations are not accepted. Please contact the shop if there's a problem with your order.

policies.title: Privacy
policies.body: Handled by Etsy's own privacy policy at checkout and messaging.
